items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I remember one time Bud Brucell and Foster Lewis had an engagement for the Oddfellas over in Biloxi, Mississippi.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's it. Yeah. A lot of the records, it seems, you know, when you're going to take a vocal, it sounds as if the drums is playing very loud, you know. Yeah, that's right. And it's probably that the mic is hanging there, I suppose. Yeah. You had to put the mic a little too close. Yeah. Going back to this depression, you know, when you had to give up. Yeah, around the 20s. Yeah, you remember Howard was playing pretty good then, and he kept going through the—
Yeah, Howard was really wonderful during them days, because I remember one time Bud Brucell and Foster Lewis had an engagement for the Oddfellas over in Biloxi, Mississippi.
